The scenario: police officer Wang was performing duty, was surrounded by defendant Qu (屈某1) and about ten others, they blocked him at his home, in a illegal building, on the second floor, pushing, pulling, for about ten minutes. During that, his police uniform was torn, his police insignia (badge) was knocked off. So they assaulted a police officer performing duty, causing damage to police uniform and insignia. Likely crime: "妨害公务" (obstructing public duty) or "非法阻碍执行职务" which is under article 277 of Criminal Law: "妨害公务罪". Also possibly "故意伤害" if they caused injury, but no mention of injury, only damage to uniform. The typical charge for assaulting police is "妨害公务罪".
